		<div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_section et_pb_section_0 et_pb_fullwidth_section et_section_regular" >
				<section class="et_pb_module et_pb_fullwidth_header et_pb_fullwidth_header_0 et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark">

			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_1 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_0">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_0  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Whether you’re in the village for work or just need a place to lay your head for a night or for a week,<br /><strong>Everything you need is already here.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Ready to book your stay?</strong><br />With the Nitinaht Lake Motel you’ll always have a clean, comfortable room waiting for you. Go ahead, book today</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4>Thank you for your patience during our Motel upgrades</h4></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="conditions" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_2 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1 et_pb_equal_columns">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_1  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Terms and Conditions</h3>
<p>Nitinaht Lake Motel is open year-round. Minimum 1 night stay.</p>
<p><strong>RESERVATIONS</strong><br />Booking Online only. <strong>Payment is by Debit/Credit card. No cash.</strong></p>
<p>$120/night: Rooms 1 &#8211; 5. Room has a single queen sized bed, micro kettle, toaster, coffee maker, bar fridge</p>
<p>$150/night: Rooms 6 &#8211; 9. Rooms are 2 bedroom with kitchenettes (micro kettle, hot plate, toaster, medium sized fridge, coffee maker). Available with 1 double/ 1 single, 2 doubles, 1 queen/1 single, 1 queen/1 double</p>
<p>Full Payment is required for all dates booked.<br />Any changes to the booking date are subject to a $50 change fee. Dates may be changed, subject to availability and are subject to the cancellation policy.</p>
<p><strong>MOTEL OCCUPANCY</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Rooms 1 &#8211; 5: maximum 2 people</li>
<li>Room 6: maximum 3 people</li>
<li>Room 7: maximum 4 people</li>
<li>Room 8: maximum 3 people</li>
<li>Room 9: maxiumn 3 people</li>
</ul></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><strong>SITE COMPOSITION</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The permit holder is responsible for the conduct and behavior of their family within the motel area.</li>
<li>Maximum 1 vehicle per room.</li>
<li>Check in time is 3:00pm</li>
<li>Check out time is 11:00am</li>
<li>Management reserves the right to refuse entry to any person.</li>
<li>Management reserves the right to refuse service to anyone for violating motel rules, destructive behavior or creating a disturbance or undermining authority of the motel staff or the Ditidaht people.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>CANCELLATION AND REFUND POLICY</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Any cancellations received within 14 days of the scheduled arrival will result in a forfeiture of your entire payment.</li>
<li>Cancellations received prior to the 14-day period are subject to 50% cancellation fee. The remainder will be refunded to your credit card.</li>
<li>We do not give credit or refunds due to weather conditions.</li>
<li>Inquiries, changes and cancellations will only be accepted by email at <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#3e5c5151555750594d7e48574d574a50574a57505f564a105d5153"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="d4b6bbbbbfbdbab3a794a2bda7bda0babda0bdbab5bca0fab7bbb9">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>. We do not accept cancellations over the phone or in person.</li>
</ul></div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Nitinaht Tourism</strong></span></p>
<p>The Nitinaht Region on the west coast of Vancouver Island ls home to some of the most wondrous natural and cultural sights and experiences - all in one beautiful, remarkable, untouched place.</p></div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Nitinaht Entrance West Coast Trail</strong></span></p>
<p>We are home to the new Parks Canada 3rd entrance to the West Coast Trail. Start here for shorter hikes and 'weekend warrior' overnight Comfort Camping.</p></div>
